top_signals.title: Malaysia’s Anwar Says No Financial Support Agreed for AirAsia
top_signals.summary: Malaysia hasn’t agreed to provide financial support to AirAsia Group Bhd. even as the airline faces losses from a sharp rise in jet fuel prices following the Middle East conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Takaichi Reaffirms No Deficit Bonds to Fund Food Sales Tax Cut
top_signals.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi reiterated that she won’t rely on special deficit-covering bonds to fund a sales tax cut on food after her earlier remarks sparked speculation that she was changing her stance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Strive scoops up another 1,223 bitcoin for $100 million as total holdings reach 36,818 BTC
top_signals.summary: Strive paid approximately $81,734 on average per bitcoin, adding to the 2,822 BTC it had acquired earlier last week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: South Korea’s $1 trillion chip bet to revive left-behind region risks Trump’s ire
top_signals.summary: Washington has bluntly said that it wants more of South Korea's artificial intelligence expansion to happen in the United States.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Indonesia to Remove Tightly Held Stocks From Benchmark Index
top_signals.summary: Indonesia will remove stocks with concentrated ownership from its benchmark equities index, the latest effort to avert a possible downgrade of its market status by MSCI Inc.

top_signals.title: ConnectWise suspends Cloud Backup service after supply chain attack
top_signals.summary: ConnectWise initially said on Friday that it was investigating “attempts of unauthorized access associated with the ConnectWise Cloud Backup environment,” and confirmed such access on Saturday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
